leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a visitor interface with typed methods for different element types
Construct concrete visitor classes that apply operations to specific element types
Configure element classes to accept visitor instances through an accept method
Initialize a visitor pattern structure with typed element collections
Manipulate element data by applying different visitor implementations
Integrate the visitor pattern into a TypeScript application with proper type safety
Control traversal logic by implementing visitor methods for each element type
